name: coordguard
description: Hard anti-clobber guard for multi-instance Claude Code. On Write/Edit it blocks (PreToolUse deny) when the target file changed on disk since this session last read it — the signature of another Claude instance editing the same file. Kept separate from coordkit so the bus stays strictly never-blocks. Caveat: a file this session modifies via the Bash tool (sed -i, formatters, git checkout) also trips the guard, since a hook can't tell which files a shell command touched — just re-Read it to proceed.
